subject: Discovery recap + PoC / integration plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@fastretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + PoC plan

Hi Jane / Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the proposed PoC/integration plan so we’re all aligned. Let me know if I missed anything.

Summary of pain points
- Slow personalization pipeline — 300–400ms 95th latency target currently missed during peak.
- High per-query cost from current vendor; want to reduce unit cost without sacrificing accuracy.
- Data residency & audit requirements for customer PII (need SOC2 + audit logs).

Current stack
- Backend: Java microservices + Node.js edge services
- Model calls today via vendor X (proprietary) using HTTP JSON API
- Trying to keep inference close to edge for latency-sensitive flows

Success criteria for PoC
1) Integrate Redwood API so core auth flow generates responses with <=250ms p50 and <=500ms p95 for our test suite
2) 20–30% cost reduction per 1k tokens on production workload profile
3) Logs + audit trail visible in Console for compliance review

Proposed integration & PoC plan (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): alignment and scoping; sign mutual action plan (attached)
- Week 1: SDK integration (we recommend Python for backend and Node.js for edge), basic request/response flow, auth + test keys
- Week 2: Evaluation — run sample traffic, capture latency profiles, and validate output quality against your test prompts
- Week 3: Performance tuning — batching, KV cache settings, and light quantization profile suggestions
- Week 4: Acceptance & handoff — compliance review, SLA discussion, rollout plan

Owners / next steps
- FastRetail: Jane (project lead), Alex (infra) — confirm access and data retention requirements
- Redwood: Marissa (AE, PoC lead), Ben (Solutions Engineer — infra + perf), Lauren (CS — onboarding & success)

Next meeting: propose 30-min technical sync with Alex + Ben on Tue 8/18 @ 9am PT — any conflicts?

Attachments: FastRetail_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (xlsx)

Looking forward — I’ll send calendar invite once you confirm the time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Hi Jane / Alex —

Great — quick answers below and a couple of notes for the technical sync on Tue.

1) SDKs:
- We provide first-class SDKs for Python and Node.js.
- Java: we don’t have a dedicated Java SDK in prod yet, but our HTTP API is fully language-agnostic and we can provide a lightweight Java examples repo. Ben will help with a starter client for your Java services during week 1.

2) API compatibility:
- Redwood exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST surface for generation and chat, plus embedding endpoints that mirror common request/response semantics.
- Streaming (chunked) responses are supported via server-sent events / chunked transfer for low-latency edge use cases.

3) Data residency & audits:
- We support region pinning for logs and retention controls. For this PoC we’ll keep logs in the US region and can provide audit logs (event-level) for the 90-day default retention.
- For longer retention (365d) or custom retention windows we’ll coordinate with your compliance team and include in the mutual action plan.

PoC timeline & owners (confirming):
- Week 1 (Integration): Marissa / Ben — API keys, sample calls, Java starter client (if needed)
- Week 2 (Evaluation): FastRetail QA + Redwood — run the test harness and share latency & quality reports
- Week 3 (Perf tuning): Ben — batching & cache profile recommendations
- Week 4 (Acceptance): Lauren — onboarding checklist, compliance sign-off

Questions for Tue sync (Alex + Ben):
- Are there outbound NAT restrictions for your services? If so we’ll coordinate IP allowlist and/or VPC setup.
- Which sample prompts & traffic profile should we prioritize for latency testing? Please attach a small prompt set (~20 examples) if possible.

I’ll send the calendar invite for Tue 8/18 9am PT and include an agenda. I’ll also upload the PoC scope doc (POC_Scope.md) to the shared link.

Best,
Marissa
